consequence.statement: Health status is no longer stored in the Application CR's .status.resources[].health by default; tools or CLI commands parsing that field must use the argocd CLI/API instead.
consequence.remediation: Set controller.resource.health.persist to true in argocd-cmd-params-cm, or update tools to use the argocd CLI/API to get health status.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0 no longer persists per-resource health under .status.resources[].health in the Application CR by default; set controller.resource.health.persist to true in argocd-cmd-params-cm to revert.
